mapping_json.motion_frame: stationary hex-caster: one cast lands a chaos-DoT-plus-full-curse-bundle on a pack, enemies melt from stacked debuffs
mapping_json.fidelity_notes: CURSE-BUNDLER: the identity is 'one cast = chaos DoT + ALL linked curses at once, with a per-curse damage multiplier'. Element chaos -> shadow (§1 chaos drain-DoT lineage). The chaos DoT maps to the DRAIN ailment (§2 life-drain/decay/chaos-DoT -> drain), NOT poison (Bane is a hex-DoT, not a stacking-venom skill). Bundled curses land as curse: variants by application-shape (§2): Despair (chaos-res hex) -> curse:amplify; Enfeeble -> curse:weaken; Temporal Chains -> curse:decrepify. Geometry ground_targeted_circle (small-area application + persistent DoT patch). NETWORK_AMPLIFIER routes the curse-network + per-curse-multiplier ('more curses = more damage' IS a curse-network amp). MILD APPROX noted in-grade: engine applies each curse as a discrete ailment; the source's 'ALL linked curses in a SINGLE cast simultaneously' is expressed as the kit applying multiple curse-ailments together, which is faithful in outcome. Occultist +1-curse and Profane Bloom (cursed-enemies-explode) are ascendancy flavor; explode-on-death of cursed enemies is a secondary on-death propagation not central to the dominant DoT loop. [STEWARD AUDIT: Despair re-routed sap->amplify — Despair is a damage-taken amp, Vulnerability-class; crosswalk §2 lacked a Despair row (law gap, now fixed).]
